summary: Nayax Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing an application with the Connecticut Department of Banking to establish Nayax America Bank Inc., a non-depository innovation bank. The proposed bank, wholly owned by new U.S. holding company Nayax USA Holdings Inc., would be headquartered in Fairfield County, Connecticut, and led by Carly Furman as CEO. The bank would offer embedded financial services, excluding deposits. The filing also announced Yellow Account, a deposit service operated by Nayax LLC under Adyen's sponsorship, launched separately from the bank charter. The charter application signifies strategic expansion into regulated financial infrastructure but does not constitute a traditional special-situation corporate event. Watch for regulatory approval progress and integration of credit products upon bank chartering.
